input:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: portrait mobile slot-game lobby background behind live UI cards
Primary request: an original joyful soft-luxury casino lobby that immediately feels like real slot gaming while remaining elegant and welcoming
Scene/backdrop: champagne-gold gaming lounge with a burgundy carpet, pearl marquee arches, rows of four visibly different premium slot cabinets receding along both sides, warm bulb ceilings, coin trays, pearls, emeralds, rubies and diamonds naturally integrated into display plinths; no people
Style/medium: high-end photorealistic 3D mobile casino environment, commercial game key art, realistic cabinets and materials, glamorous but soft
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3, symmetric perspective toward a bright central jackpot stage, central 65 percent kept visually quiet and darker for cards and readable UI, wealth details frame outer edges, no large object blocks the center
Lighting/mood: warm diffused marquee glow, champagne reflections, gentle festive sparkles, energetic gambling-floor atmosphere, inviting rather than solemn
Color palette: cream, champagne gold, deep burgundy, pearl white, soft rose gold, small emerald and ruby accents
Constraints: at least four distinct real slot cabinets visible at the sides; no characters; no text; no letters; no numbers; no logos; no watermark; no currency symbols; no recognizable brand or copied cabinet
Avoid: empty palace, temple, dark smoky casino, harsh neon, nightclub, cheap yellow plastic, cluttered center, flat vector art
